title: Rank 1: Digital Twin of Atlantis
description: This blueprint is a digital twin of Atlantis, and it is labeled MYTHOLOGICAL throughout: Atlantis is a story told by Plato, not an established historical city, and no part of this record claims that the city has been found.
body:
This blueprint is a digital twin of Atlantis, and it is labeled MYTHOLOGICAL throughout: Atlantis is a story told by Plato, not an established historical city, and no part of this record claims that the city has been found.

Plato's account in the Timaeus and Critias describes concentric rings of land and water, a central island with a temple, and a great harbor, and this blueprint follows that account ring by ring. Modern interpretations, such as reading the rings as a harbor plan rather than a literal island, are stated separately from Plato's text wherever they differ.

Rank

Rank 1 of 16.

Ranking scores (round 2, final)

  • source-faithfulness: 10/10
  • level-fit: 10/10
  • engineering feasibility: 10/10
  • buildability at stated scale: 10/10
  • completeness at its level: 10/10
  • testability: 10/10
  • Total: 60/60

Technology level

Technology level L1. Available now: buildable or representable with existing tools, materials, and data.

Feasibility label

demonstrated

Layout

A complete digital model of the concentric-ring city described by Plato, built from the text's measurements and marked wherever the text is silent.

Dimensions

Outer ring diameter 1,270 m in the model (Plato's figure of about 127 stadia is converted and labeled as an interpretation, not a surveyed fact); central island 380 m across; canal widths 30 m, 60 m, and 90 m from the center outward.

Walls and gates

Digital walls and gates: a stone wall ring at each canal, with gates and bridges at the south, modeled as the text describes and labeled as reconstruction, not excavation.

Districts

  • Central island citadel: temple, palace, and sacred precinct at the center
  • Inner ring districts: housing and workshops between the first and second canals
  • Middle ring districts: markets, barracks, and harbors of the model
  • Outer ring and harbor: the great harbor, docks, and sea gates
  • Agricultural plain: the rectangular plain beyond the rings, with canals and field divisions

Ecosystems

  • Open sea and harbor water
  • canal waterways between the rings
  • the agricultural plain and its irrigation channels
  • the sky above the model and the coastal hills behind it

Caves / Underground

Caves and underground: the digital twin's underground is modeled explicitly, not omitted: cisterns, drainage channels, foundation courses, and service passages beneath the rings, plus a labeled survey layer for any grotto or spring chamber the text implies. Where the text gives no cave, the model says so on that layer.

Materials

Digital materials only at this level: surveyed stone, bronze, and timber textures applied to measured geometry, with every texture labeled as interpretation.

Lighting and power

Lighting and power: the model renders daylight, torchlight, and lamp light as light studies; no physical power system is claimed at this level.

Scale treatment

Scale treatment: full city at digital scale, 1:1 in the model, with a printable 1:5000 site plan. No physical building is claimed.

Acceptance tests

  • The model's ring diameters match the stated figures within 1 percent.
  • Every district, ecosystem, and underground layer renders and is labeled.
  • Every measurement the text does not give is flagged as inferred, with no inferred figure presented as Plato's.

demo.code:
RADII = [190.0, 320.0, 460.0, 635.0]
print("Ring plan: Digital Twin of Atlantis")
import math
prev = 0.0
for i, r in enumerate(RADII, 1):
    print("Ring %d radius %.0f m, circumference %.0f m, ring area %.0f sq m" % (i, r, 2 * math.pi * r, math.pi * (r * r - prev * prev)))
    prev = r
print("Outer diameter: %.0f m" % (2 * RADII[-1]))
demo.expected_output:
Ring plan: Digital Twin of Atlantis
Ring 1 radius 190 m, circumference 1194 m, ring area 113411 sq m
Ring 2 radius 320 m, circumference 2011 m, ring area 208288 sq m
Ring 3 radius 460 m, circumference 2890 m, ring area 343062 sq m
Ring 4 radius 635 m, circumference 3990 m, ring area 602008 sq m
Outer diameter: 1270 m

ecosystems: the agricultural plain and its irrigation channels
the sky above the model and the coastal hills behind it

  • Ring order matches Plato's account: land and water alternate from the center outward.
  • The south harbor entrance is a single continuous route in plan and model.

Layout

The fullest future outcome: a living city that matches Plato's ring plan at full scale and full population, with the temple, palace, harbor, and plain all inhabited. This is the Level 4 endpoint of the path, labeled not-established, and it ranks last among the shipped options because feasibility and buildability at this scale are the lowest, however complete the vision.

Dimensions

Rings to 1,270 m outer diameter; plain 12.0 km by 8.0 km; population in the plan 120,000; temple platform 60 m by 40 m.

Walls and gates

Walls and gates: full ring walls with gates at the south of each ring, a harbor wall with sea gates, and plain boundary gates at every canal crossing.

Districts

  • Citadel temple and palace island: the temple and palace as living civic buildings
  • Ring neighborhoods: homes, schools, and workshops on all three rings
  • Harbor city: the port, docks, and trade city
  • Plain farm cities: farm towns across the plain
  • Assembly and festival grounds: the plain's great gathering grounds

Ecosystems

Caves / Underground

Caves and underground: the living city's underground is explicit: a complete undercity of transit, service, cistern, and archive levels beneath the rings, plus designed grotto halls under the citadel, labeled as designed. No ancient cave city is claimed, and no lower level claims this undercity.

Materials

Materials: stone, concrete, timber, and future materials as specified at build time; no future material is claimed as available today.

Lighting and power

Lighting and power: city power 120 MW from offshore wind, solar, storage, and interconnection. Full closure is future work and is labeled as such.

Scale treatment

Scale treatment: living full-scale city at Level 4 only. Never presented as available at Levels 1 to 3.

Acceptance tests
